steps.npc: You looked like you wanted to speak to me, you halfwit. You dullard.
My contract stipulates that I must follow you, you insufferable ignoramus. My contract does not stipulate that I must be polite, you ignorant buffoon.

steps.player: What have I ever done to you?

steps.npc: How about parading me around like a trophy, you idiot clown? How about stuffing me in your rotten backpack, you inclement cretin? How about-

steps.text: The player and Yami simultaneously continue:

steps.npc: -locking me in your house, you absolutely intolerable moron.

steps.player: Why would I do that after all of that rudeness?

steps.npc: I do not have the patience for you today.
You want to 'chat'? It is not enough that I must stare at your backside all day, I must suffer your sorry attempts at conversation as well?

steps.player: Well if you're going to be rude, I'll find somebody else.

steps.npc: Somebody else? Who? Introduce me to this paragon of virtue, who can tolerate the torrent of spittle you call speech. The incoherent messes you call sentences.
Oh yes, your friends. And do these friends, perhaps, live very far away? Are they perhaps too busy to meet up frequently?
If anybody wanted to 'chat' with you, you wouldn't be speaking to somebody contractually obliged to do so.

upon-reclaiming-from-probita.npc: The next time I am left stranded by your incompetence, which I'm sure won't take long, do us both a favour and don't reclaim me.

overhead-dialogue-battling-another-pet-i.npc: I could incinerate you if I wanted.
I'm holding back because this house is actually habitable.
